The '''Luire system''', also known as the '''Nyriaan system''', was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], near to the border with the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It had seven planets: [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]], [[Caillte]] and five [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]]. It was first discovered in [[4129 BBY]].
